page.text:
Gathering all equivalence classes into a new set yields the *quotient
set*: $$X / R := \{[x]_R : x \in X\}$$ Passing to the quotient is
mathematics' universal engine of abstraction: it forgets irrelevant
distinguishing details, collapsing entire equivalence classes into single
points. The canonical quotient projection $\pi : X \to X / R$, defined by
$\pi(x) = [x]_R$, is the prototypical surjective homomorphism.
